T0554.title: Data Broker
T0554.definition: An organization or individual that collects, aggregates, processes, shares, or sells data from multiple sources.
T0554.description: Data brokers aggregate data from multiple sources into profiles, attributes, or lookup services. The risk is not only single-source leakage but the higher sensitivity created by cross-source linkage. Controls focus on source legality, consent chains, data minimization, sharing audits, and third-party exit mechanisms.
T0554.usageExample: Assess Data Broker related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
